notes.title: Dev Update Sept 2019
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32896087/964037799d4944188d34416ac382c2180c6eb5b4.png[/img]

Hi Everyone,

After I nervously released the pre alpha Demo a few months ago players have provided lots & lots of feedback about the look, feel and content of Hive Quest.
So I've been taking all the comments on board and have been busy making adjustments and improvements that include:

- better models for trees and bushes
- snappier game play
- better lighting

One of the biggest gains here has been the switch from Gamma to Linear lighting, taking things from a cartoony appearance to a softer more realistic look.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32896087/b7992772adb97c2fb7b97df797e4fdfa738dc33d.png[/img]

New strategy elements are also being included that weren't really there in the demo version, along with options to micromanage your hive more.

Choosing which eggs to hatch is a new micromanage feature - after the Queen lays them, you can scope each egg's individual traits to make sure you only hatch the best drones for your hive. If you find yourself in a pinch however, you might just have to make do...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32896087/38bd1144ea05dc7406f17987536fb8ae93b48ab9.png[/img]

At this very moment I am working on making the sites where resources are obtained as strong sources of conflict between Hives. This is a core piece of gameplay that guarantees the need to strategize and prioritize how you grow your Hive and use your drones.

You can get involved & meet new fans of the game on the [url=https://discord.gg/qCpKSpP]Hive Quest Discord[/url]

[url=https://twitter.com/RodatGHG]or on Twitter[/url]

Or even consider [url=https://www.patreon.com/HiveQuest]checking out the Patreon[/url] too where you can gain access to new, exclusive info and even scope my 'orrible fizzog :P

I'm Rod btw, the slightly unhinged solo dev behind the game. Nice to meet you :)

More news on its way soon - many thanks for looking!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32896087/fe2dce8acfc6146672f15bfb630aa5c5c74a91de.png[/img]

notes.title: Game Dev update 1
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32896087/5d0e03c7bd18f4c6a37138ae5f102d0cad144736.png[/img]

Hi Everyone, Quick update on how the world of Hive Quest and the characters within it are coming together. The game is really taking shape to be a special mix of exploration, discovery, story telling, puzzle solving and real time strategy. Mixing all those elements together might sound a little crazy but the ultimate goal is to create a unique, memorable and pleasing experience.

Here's a few screenshots featuring some of the latest developments in the game :)

First off, Nora the Hedgewitch, a horrid old lady who spends her days combing the hedgerows for strange creatures and faeries that she can capture and add to her grim collection.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32896087/b82038bd14a2c5cc0b9ee8de04cebf947893939e.png[/img]

And there's also the Snail Rider clan - I wonder what mischief this lot will get up to?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32896087/7f19e14bde90b322883d7a88efcaa1a96292f310.png[/img]
